en.headline: Man arrested over H8 building sprinkler attack that disabled three lifts
en.dek: A 21-year-old man was arrested after a fire sprinkler head was smashed with a baseball bat on 1 August, flooding lift shafts at the Tsim Sha Tsui commercial building and putting all three lifts out of service for days.
body: Police have arrested a 21-year-old man in connection with a criminal damage case at the H8 commercial building on Hau Fook Street in Tsim Sha Tsui. Officers said a fire sprinkler head on the 19th floor was smashed with a baseball bat in the early hours of 1 August, causing large volumes of water to flood the three lift shafts and disable all lifts in the 25-storey building.

Investigators believe the suspect, described as a triad member, had earlier argued with his girlfriend inside a licensed bar on the same floor and was ejected by staff. He later returned with four other men. After forcing entry, the group damaged the sprinkler head in the lift lobby before leaving. The lifts remained out of service for several days, severely affecting restaurants and other businesses in the building.

Police arrested the 21-year-old man on 2 August and are seeking four other men. The case is classified as criminal damage and is being handled by the Yau Tsim district anti-triad unit. Management of the building said electronic and control components in the lifts required thorough inspection before services could resume safely.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀H8大廈花灑遭棒球棍破壞 21歲男子被捕
zh.dek: 一名21歲男子涉於8月1日以棒球棍擊毀消防花灑頭，導致三部升降機入水停運多日，警方已拘捕該男子並追緝另外四人。
body: 警方拘捕一名21歲男子，涉嫌於尖沙咀厚福街H8商廈干犯刑事毀壞。調查指8月1日清晨，大廈19樓一個消防花灑頭被人以棒球棍擊毀，大量食水湧入三部升降機及機槽，令樓高25層的大廈全部升降機癱瘓多日。
消息指該名有三合會背景的男子早前在同層一間持牌酒吧與女友發生爭執後被職員驅逐，其後連同另外四名男子折返。他們闖入酒吧後再於升降機大堂擊毀花灑頭。事件令大廈內多間食肆生意大受打擊，部分高層餐廳暫停營業，其他商戶則推出優惠吸引顧客行樓梯光顧。
警方於8月2日拘捕該21歲男子，正追緝另外四人。案件列作刑事毀壞，由油尖警區反三合會行動組跟進。大廈管理處表示，升降機內多項精密電子及控制組件須完成檢查並確認安全後，方可恢復服務。
